name: Chitterwood Refugee

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
As the Goblinblood Wars raged through Isger, you were a resident of the Chitterwood region who stubbornly refused to relocate throughout the conflict and instead tried to defend your home. When the victorious armies—and vengeful Isgeri survivors—set the entire region aflame, you and the others who stayed had no choice but to finally flee. You found fire everywhere you turned, and you adapted, using the flames as a crucible in which you forged yourself anew.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Chitterwood Lore skill. You gain the Forged in Fire reaction.
